format_description: NLM benchmark dataset. Single persona (Vitalii Halak, aka Hantes) with realistic personal AI assistant conversation history. 100 memories total: 60 in-play (referenced by queries) + 40 background filler that creates semantic noise. 30 queries across 6 categories. Friends, pet, and most personal specifics are fictionalized; only the publicly known core identity is real.
